crossRefs.note: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,

people.name: Joel
people.line: A Benjaminite leader in Jerusalem after the Exile

people.name: Judah
people.line: Leader of Judahites living in Jerusalem

people.name: Senaah
people.line: A leader from the tribe of Benjamin

people.name: Zichri
people.line: Son of Joab, a leader in Jerusalem

translations.web: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
translations.bsb: Joel son of Zichri was the officer over them, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the Second District of the city.
translations.kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
translations.asv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
